WITH telescope_obs AS (
    SELECT 
        t.telescregistry,
        t.bandusagepct,
        obs.lunarstage,
        obs.observstation
    FROM telescopes t
    INNER JOIN observatories obs ON t.observstation = obs.observstation
),
station_avgs AS (
    SELECT 
        lunarstage,
        observstation,
        AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bw
    FROM telescope_obs
    WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY lunarstage, observstation
),
phase_avgs AS (
    SELECT 
        lunarstage,
        AVG(avg_bw) as avg_bandwidth
    FROM station_avgs
    GROUP BY lunarstage
),
counts AS (
    SELECT 
        lunarstage,
        COUNT(*) as count_records
    FROM telescope_obs
    GROUP BY lunarstage
),
total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM telescope_obs
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.lunarstage, '<null>') as phase,
    pa.avg_bandwidth,
    c.count_records,
    100.0 * c.count_records / t.total_count as share_pct
FROM counts c
LEFT JOIN phase_avgs pa ON COALESCE(c.lunarstage, 'NULL_SENTINEL_99876543210') = COALESCE(pa.lunarstage, 'NULL_SENTINEL_99876543210')
CROSS JOIN total t
ORDER BY c.lunarstage
